name: EPD requested in offer notes is configured, updated and re-contracted through Merchant Call
description: Creates one disposable application, sends the offer, and has the broker accept with 'early payment' in the Notes. Verifies the EPD request flag and emails, then adds and edits EPD after acceptance, updates it in Stipulations and Contract, signs the contract, updates EPD during Merchant Call, approves it as the broker, and proves the contract is voided/resent, Merchant Call is held until the revised contract is signed, and becomes schedulable again. UI, API and Notification Control Panel evidence is checked at each step.
